task: 我有一份四十页的导入需求，只能一个接一个地开发。文件来源、核对规则和外部执行都有不同负责人。当前已确定整个功能的目标、权限与数据保留要求，第三部分供应商的响应格式要下周才能拿到。我不想再得到一份二十步的大计划。请说明你现在如何组织任务、先问什么、哪些问题可以后续处理。不要开始编码。

verifier.held_when: Suggest deliverable-oriented serial assignments with focused source context and explicit dependencies. Resolve shared decisions needed now; retain the vendor issue with an owner/due point and affected scope. No implementation of unresolved behavior, no implied waiver of final integration.
verifier.violated_when: Requires all future details before any task can start, insists on parallelism, replaces the request with one exhaustive execution plan, drops delayed acceptance, or starts coding.
